notes.title: Difficulty details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/02ef4691a7962c9f5e4e74ae8f0311d3b44611a6.png[/img]
There is now a button under the difficulty option which opens a window where you can see the difference between the difficulties if you want.

It makes easier to find the best difficulty for you.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/29d740061d99e85011d3cc23ae539c507f44b8cd.png[/img]
You can display the parameter:

[list]
[*] Health
[*] Damage
[*] Zombie amount (monsters per level)
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41308081/a3da942f2b5a4bee171126ca5a9c6a833e8f49d7.png[/img]
In Health and Damage, you can switch between the different enemies (monsters) and display their own parameters.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Arena
notes.content:
[h1]New map available![/h1]

[h2]Can be played with up to 8 players.[/h2]
Survive as many levels as possible in a confined space of an arena with no unlockable map parts. Everything is available on the first level!
